recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中唯一的白血球是一顆中型母細胞：染色質細緻、核質比高、只有少量藍色細胞質且無 Auer 小體；背景紅血球有數個淚滴狀細胞、血小板稀少，符合白血球低下伴隨循環母細胞。
features: Solitary medium-sized circulating blast as the only leukocyte in the field
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not well seen
Red cells show mild poikilocytosis with teardrop forms; platelets decreased
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single circulating blast with a high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm, without Auer rods. No neutrophils are present in the field, consistent with the reported neutropenia. Red cells show mild poikilocytosis with scattered teardrop cells, and platelets appear decreased. Findings indicate circulating blasts with cytopenias; blast lineage requires flow cytometry, and in this case the findings support acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells and coarser chromatin than this blast.
Lymphoblasts are morphologically indistinguishable without Auer rods, requiring MPO cytochemistry or flow cytometry.
Myelofibrosis shows numerous teardrop cells with nucleated red cells and immature granulocytes, and marrow fibrosis rather than 20% or more blasts.
